name: Digital River Networks
summary: Melbourne dark-fibre + Metro Ethernet provider (Digital River Networks Pty Ltd, ACN 098 597 329, founded ~Oct 2001); became a regional WISP via HIBIS/Broadband Connect grants (2004-06); dark-fibre assets and metro-Ethernet contracts sold to Vocus for $3.95m (announced 8 Apr 2011); members' voluntary liquidation 2020.

events.details: Founded in Melbourne as a metro fibre infrastructure developer (ACN 098 597 329).
Dark-fibre assets + contracts sold to Vocus ($3.95m cash).
